worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.summary: Lock a reachable spot and throw a rigged bouquet: it does not curve after release, and the first enemy it touches bursts it, driving every petal into the weak point (always a critical hit). Hitting the ground or a wall only scatters petals. The high arc clears low cover to land behind it, but flies slower.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.use.0: Put one committed strike on a target
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.use.1: Reach a target behind low cover
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.use.2: Land a guaranteed critical on a target that stops or moves slowly
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.descriptio: The bouquet bursts on the enemy for %1$s Grass physical damage, and the hit is always a critical.

Throw range %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick; a reachable spot is locked before the throw, the bouquet never curves after release, bursts on an enemy, and only scatters petals on ground, walls or allies.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.targeting: Pick any entity regardless of side, or just a direction or world point; with no living target the arc is solved to the direction endpoint and a miss only scatters petals without dealing damage.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.highArc.on: High arc: the highest reachable solution is thrown, clearing low cover to land behind it, at the cost of a slower bouquet, a little less range and bloom power, and longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.highArc.of: Flat throw: faster and farther with more bloom power, but low cover blocks the arc.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.growth.0: From level %1$s the bloom rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.growth.1: From level %1$s the bloom rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.flowertrick.preference: On (high arc): the highest reachable solution is thrown, clearing low cover to land behind it, but bouquet speed x0.85, range x0.92, bloom power x0.85, +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown. Off (flat): faster, farther and stronger, but low cover blocks the arc.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in before throwing; larger values let it open from further away.
On: lower-health targets rank higher, since this one committed, non-homing strike is best saved for a kill; off: ordinary ranged ordering.
